sample_metadata.scope_limitation_disclosure: Analyzed sample covers consecutive chronological window from 2026-07-01T05:49:54.563429Z to 2026-07-01T07:48:27.491649Z (7112.9s, 249,995 tick executions). Microstructure empirical parameters (scaling exponent, autocorrelation, point-mass proportions) reflect this specific intraday regime and cannot be extrapolated to full 24-hour trading without cross-regime validation.

wls_fit.name: Weighted Least Squares (weighted by tier sample count)
wls_fit.se_type: Classical WLS SE (unadjusted for cross-tier residual autocorrelation)

trade_level_fit.name: Trade-Level Log-Log HAC (Positive Response Sub-Sample: R > 0)
trade_level_fit.conditioning: Strictly conditional on positive signed price displacement (R_i > 0)
trade_level_fit.caveat: Evaluated on 52,606 systematically sampled trades (stride=2 from 105,211 positive price displacement trades, 42.1% of sample); cannot serve as an unconditional full-sample validation because zero and adverse price moves (144,784 trades, 57.9% of sample) are dropped by the log transform.

out_of_sample_validation.description: 50% chronological split with purged transition buffer
out_of_sample_validation.purging_rationale: Purged 5 boundary trades to eliminate lookahead return leakage across horizon k=5
out_of_sample_validation.note: Evaluates training-fitted parameters on held-out test data. Power-law and logarithmic parameters are strictly fitted on the training split prior to lookahead purge buffer.

moving_block_bootstrap.methodology: Moving Block Bootstrap with economic tier re-stratification
moving_block_bootstrap.sensitivity_summary: Confidence interval containment behavior for both H0: gamma = 0 and H0: gamma = 0.5 is uniform across evaluated block lengths.

hypothesis_test_sqrt_law.null_hypothesis: H0: gamma = 0.5 (Square-Root Law for Child Trades)
hypothesis_test_sqrt_law.interpretation: Square-root price impact is an empirical scaling relationship. This study estimates the power-law exponent under specified assets, intraday sample intervals, and regression specifications to evaluate compatibility with gamma = 0.5 (WLS gamma = -0.0723, 95% WLS CI: [-0.1561, 0.0115], encompasses zero) rejects compatibility with square-root exponent gamma = 0.5 (t = -13.39, p = 0.0000e+00); OLS gamma = -0.0800, 95% OLS CI: [-0.1904, 0.0303], encompasses zero) rejects H0: gamma = 0.5 (t = -10.30, p = 0.0000e+00). Results do not demonstrate universal or cross-asset validity. Child-order tick response cannot be conflated with exogenous meta-order impact or guaranteed execution alpha. Models exhibit low in-sample and out-of-sample explanatory power.
